strings.name: May-Britt Moser
strings.summary: Moser studied psychology and neurophysiology in Oslo, then built a Trondheim team with Edvard Moser. She helped discover entorhinal grid cells, revealing spatial coordinate coding, and continued studying navigation and memory. She shared the 2014 medicine Nobel with Edvard Moser and O’Keefe and promoted interdisciplinary research and training.
strings.influence.rationale: Advances research on the brain’s spatial positioning system, helping discover grid cells and deepen understanding of navigation and memory mechanisms.
strings.facts.f2.value: University of Oslo: psychology degree (1990), neurophysiology doctorate (1995).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Discovery of grid cells
strings.highlights.h1.text: The team found entorhinal cells with grid-like firing patterns, illuminating spatial coordinate coding.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Building collaborative research
strings.highlights.h2.text: Co-built research platforms in Trondheim linking behaviour experiments with neural recordings.
strings.timeline.t1.title: New cortex algorithms centre
strings.timeline.t1.text: Co-established the Centre for Algorithms in the Cortex for neural circuit and cognition research.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Shared Nobel Prize
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shared the physiology or medicine prize with Edvard Moser and John O’Keefe.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Established Kavli institute
strings.timeline.t3.text: Co-established the Kavli Institute for Systems Neuroscience, expanding team research.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Reported grid cells
strings.timeline.t4.text: Published the team’s grid-cell discovery, advancing understanding of the brain’s positioning system.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Promoted to professor
strings.timeline.t5.text: Promoted to professor of neuroscience at NTNU.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined NTNU
strings.timeline.t6.text: Returned to Norway and established a Trondheim laboratory with the collaborator.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Completed doctorate
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed doctoral training in Oslo and learned place-cell recording with O’Keefe.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Fosnavåg
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in a Norwegian coastal town; later studied in Oslo.
